verses.original: וַיַּאַסְפ֨וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֤ים אֶת־ מַֽחֲנֵיהֶם֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַיֵּאָ֣סְפ֔וּ שֹׂכֹ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִיהוּדָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֛וּ בֵּין־ שׂוֹכֹ֥ה וּבֵין־ עֲזֵקָ֖ה בְּאֶ֥פֶס דַּמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·’as·p̄ū p̄ə·liš·tîm ’eṯ- ma·ḥă·nê·hem lam·mil·ḥā·māh way·yê·’ā·sə·p̄ū śō·ḵōh ’ă·šer lî·hū·ḏāh way·ya·ḥă·nū bên- śō·w·ḵōh ū·ḇên- ‘ă·zê·qāh bə·’e·p̄es dam·mîm
verses.literal: Now the Philistines gathered their forces for war . . . at Socoh in Judah and they camped between Socoh . . . and Azekah in Ephes-dammim
verses.literalPt: Ajuntando os filisteus as suas forças para a guerra, vieram a unir-se em Socó, que pertence a Judá, e acamparam-se entre Socó e Azeca, em Efes-Damim.

verses.original: וְשָׁא֤וּל וְאִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נֶאֶסְפ֔וּ וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּעֵ֣מֶק הָאֵלָ֑ה וַיַּעַרְכ֥וּ מִלְחָמָ֖ה לִקְרַ֥את פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·’ūl wə·’îš- yiś·rā·’êl ne·’es·p̄ū way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·‘ê·meq hā·’ê·lāh way·ya·‘ar·ḵū mil·ḥā·māh liq·raṯ pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: Saul and the men of Israel assembled and camped in the Valley of Elah arraying themselves for battle against the Philistines
verses.literalPt: Saul, porém, e os filhos de Israel, tendo-se ajuntado, acamparam-se no vale de Elá e ordenaram a batalha para ir de encontro aos filisteus.

verses.original: וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֞ים עֹמְדִ֤ים אֶל־ הָהָר֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֹמְדִ֥ים אֶל־ הָהָ֖ר מִזֶּ֑ה וְהַגַּ֖יְא בֵּינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm ‘ō·mə·ḏîm ’el- hā·hār miz·zeh wə·yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·mə·ḏîm ’el- hā·hār miz·zeh wə·hag·gay bê·nê·hem
verses.literal: The Philistines stood on one hill and the Israelites stood on another with the valley between them
verses.literalPt: Os filisteus estavam na encosta dum monte, e Israel, na encosta de outro monte; e entre eles, um vale.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֤א אִֽישׁ־ הַבֵּנַ֙יִם֙ מִמַּחֲנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים גָּלְיָ֥ת שְׁמ֖וֹ מִגַּ֑ת גָּבְה֕וֹ שֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת וָזָֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ’îš- hab·bê·na·yim mim·ma·ḥă·nō·wṯ pə·liš·tîm gā·lə·yāṯ šə·mōw mig·gaṯ gā·ḇə·hōw šêš ’am·mō·wṯ wā·zā·reṯ
verses.literal: Then a champion . . . named Goliath who was from Gath came out from the Philistine camp He was six cubits and a span in height
verses.literalPt: Do arraial dos filisteus saiu um campeão, cujo nome era Golias, de Gate, que tinha de altura seis cúbitos e um palmo.

verses.original: וְכ֤וֹבַע נְחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ עַל־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וְשִׁרְי֥וֹן קַשְׂקַשִּׂ֖ים ה֣וּא לָב֑וּשׁ וּמִשְׁקַל֙ הַשִּׁרְי֔וֹן חֲמֵשֶׁת־ אֲלָפִ֥ים שְׁקָלִ֖ים נְחֹֽשֶֽׁת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵō·w·ḇa‘ nə·ḥō·šeṯ ‘al- rō·šōw wə·šir·yō·wn qaś·qaś·śîm hū lā·ḇūš ū·miš·qal haš·šir·yō·wn ḥă·mê·šeṯ- ’ă·lā·p̄îm šə·qā·lîm nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: and he had a bronze helmet on his head He wore a bronze coat of mail weighing . . . five thousand shekels
verses.literalPt: Trazia na cabeça um capacete de cobre e vinha vestido de uma couraça escameada, cujo peso era de cinco mil siclos de cobre.

verses.original: וּמִצְחַ֥ת נְחֹ֖שֶׁת עַל־ רַגְלָ֑יו וְכִיד֥וֹן נְחֹ֖שֶׁת בֵּ֥ין כְּתֵפָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miṣ·ḥaṯ nə·ḥō·šeṯ ‘al- raḡ·lāw wə·ḵî·ḏō·wn nə·ḥō·šeṯ bên kə·ṯê·p̄āw
verses.literal: and he had armor of bronze on his legs and a javelin of bronze slung between his shoulders
verses.literalPt: Tinha as pernas cobertas de umas grevas de cobre e um dardo de cobre, entre os ombros.

verses.original: וְחָץ חֲנִית֗וֹ כִּמְנוֹר֙ אֹֽרְגִ֔ים וְלַהֶ֣בֶת חֲנִית֔וֹ שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת שְׁקָלִ֖ים בַּרְזֶ֑ל וְנֹשֵׂ֥א הַצִּנָּ֖ה הֹלֵ֥ךְ לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥå̄ṣ ḥă·nî·ṯōw kim·nō·wr ’ō·rə·ḡîm wə·la·he·ḇeṯ ḥă·nî·ṯōw šêš- mê·’ō·wṯ šə·qā·lîm bar·zel wə·nō·śê haṣ·ṣin·nāh hō·lêḵ lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: The shaft of his spear was like a weaver’s beam and its iron point weighed six hundred shekels In addition, his shield bearer . . . went before him
verses.literalPt: A haste da sua lança era como o órgão de um tear, e a ponta da sua lança pesava seiscentos siclos de ferro. Diante dele ia o seu escudeiro.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֗ד וַיִּקְרָא֙ אֶל־ מַעַרְכֹ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם לָ֥מָּה תֵצְא֖וּ לַעֲרֹ֣ךְ מִלְחָמָ֑ה הֲל֧וֹא אָנֹכִ֣י הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֗י וְאַתֶּם֙ עֲבָדִ֣ים לְשָׁא֔וּל בְּרוּ־ לָכֶ֥ם אִ֖ישׁ וְיֵרֵ֥ד אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ way·yiq·rā ’el- ma·‘ar·ḵōṯ yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer lā·hem lām·māh ṯê·ṣə·’ū la·‘ă·rōḵ mil·ḥā·māh hă·lō·w ’ā·nō·ḵî hap·pə·liš·tî wə·’at·tem ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lə·šā·’ūl bə·rū- lā·ḵem ’îš wə·yê·rêḏ ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: And Goliath stood and shouted to the ranks of Israel Why do you come out and array yourselves for battle Am I not a Philistine and are you not servants of Saul Choose one of your men and have him come down against me
verses.literalPt: Posto em pé, clamava às tropas de Israel e dizia-lhes: Por que saístes a formar a linha de batalha? Não sou eu filisteu, e vós, servos de Saul? Escolhei um homem, e desça a ter comigo.

verses.original: אִם־ יוּכַ֞ל לְהִלָּחֵ֤ם אִתִּי֙ וְהִכָּ֔נִי וְהָיִ֥ינוּ לָכֶ֖ם לַעֲבָדִ֑ים וְאִם־ אֲנִ֤י אֽוּכַל־ לוֹ֙ וְהִכִּיתִ֔יו וִהְיִ֤יתֶם לָ֙נוּ֙ לַעֲבָדִ֔ים וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֖ם אֹתָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yū·ḵal lə·hil·lā·ḥêm ’it·tî wə·hik·kā·nî wə·hā·yî·nū lā·ḵem la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm wə·’im- ’ă·nî ’ū·ḵal- lōw wə·hik·kî·ṯîw wih·yî·ṯem lā·nū la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tem ’ō·ṯā·nū
verses.literal: If he is able to fight me and kill me then we will be your servants But if I prevail against him and kill him then you shall be our servants and work for us
verses.literalPt: Se ele puder pelejar comigo e tirar-me a vida, seremos vossos servos; mas, se eu prevalecer contra ele e lhe tirar a vida, sereis nossos servos e nos servireis.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י אֲנִ֗י חֵרַ֛פְתִּי אֶת־ מַעַרְכ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה תְּנוּ־ לִ֣י אִ֔ישׁ וְנִֽלָּחֲמָ֖ה יָֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hap·pə·liš·tî ’ă·nî ḥê·rap̄·tî ’eṯ- ma·‘ar·ḵō·wṯ yiś·rā·’êl hay·yō·wm haz·zeh tə·nū- lî ’îš wə·nil·lā·ḥă·māh yā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: Then the Philistine said I defy the ranks of Israel this day Give me a man to fight . . .
verses.literalPt: Acrescentou o filisteu: Eu desafio, hoje, as tropas de Israel. Dai-me um homem, para que pelejemos a sós.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע שָׁאוּל֙ וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיֵּחַ֥תּוּ וַיִּֽרְא֖וּ מְאֹֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ šā·’ūl wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- diḇ·rê hap·pə·liš·tî hā·’êl·leh way·yê·ḥat·tū way·yir·’ū mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: On hearing the words of the Philistine Saul and all the Israelites were dismayed and greatly afraid
verses.literalPt: Quando Saul e todo o Israel ouviram as palavras do filisteu, ficaram desalentados e com muito medo.

verses.original: וְדָוִד֩ בֶּן־ אִ֨ישׁ אֶפְרָתִ֜י הַזֶּ֗ה מִבֵּ֥ית לֶ֙חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּשְׁמ֣וֹ יִשַׁ֔י וְל֖וֹ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה בָנִ֑ים וְהָאִישׁ֙ בִּימֵ֣י שָׁא֔וּל זָקֵ֖ן בָּ֥א בַאֲנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·wiḏ ben- ’îš ’ep̄·rā·ṯî haz·zeh mib·bêṯ le·ḥem yə·hū·ḏāh ū·šə·mōw yi·šay wə·lōw šə·mō·nāh ḇā·nîm wə·hā·’îš bî·mê šā·’ūl zā·qên bā ḇa·’ă·nā·šîm
verses.literal: Now David was the son of a man named Jesse an Ephrathite from Bethlehem of Judah who had eight sons . . . And in the days of Saul Jesse was old and well along in years
verses.literalPt: Ora, Davi era filho daquele efratita de Belém-Judá cujo nome era Jessé, que tinha oito filhos e, nos dias de Saul, era homem idoso e adiantado em anos entre os homens.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשַׁי֙ הַגְּדֹלִ֔ים הָלְכ֥וּ אַחֲרֵי־ שָׁא֖וּל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְשֵׁ֣ם׀ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת בָּנָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלְכוּ֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה אֱלִיאָ֣ב הַבְּכ֗וֹר וּמִשְׁנֵ֙הוּ֙ אֲבִ֣ינָדָ֔ב וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁ֖י שַׁמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū šə·lō·šeṯ bə·nê- yi·šay hag·gə·ḏō·lîm hā·lə·ḵū ’a·ḥă·rê- šā·’ūl lam·mil·ḥā·māh wə·šêm šə·lō·šeṯ bā·nāw ’ă·šer hā·lə·ḵū bam·mil·ḥā·māh ’ĕ·lî·’āḇ hab·bə·ḵō·wr ū·miš·nê·hū ’ă·ḇî·nā·ḏāḇ wə·haš·šə·li·šî šam·māh
verses.literal: The three older sons of Jesse had followed . . . Saul into battle - - . . . The firstborn was Eliab the second was Abinadab and the third was Shammah
verses.literalPt: Os três filhos mais velhos de Jessé tinham seguido Saul à guerra; e eram os nomes dos seus três filhos que foram à guerra: Eliabe, o primogênito; o segundo, Abinadabe; e o terceiro, Samá.

verses.original: וְדָוִ֖ד ה֣וּא הַקָּטָ֑ן וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ הַגְּדֹלִ֔ים הָלְכ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·wiḏ hū haq·qā·ṭān ū·šə·lō·šāh hag·gə·ḏō·lîm hā·lə·ḵū ’a·ḥă·rê šā·’ūl
verses.literal: And David . . . was the youngest The three oldest had followed . . . Saul
verses.literalPt: Davi era o mais moço; os três maiores seguiram a Saul.

verses.original: וְדָוִ֛ד הֹלֵ֥ךְ וָשָׁ֖ב מֵעַ֣ל שָׁא֑וּל לִרְע֛וֹת אֶת־ צֹ֥אן אָבִ֖יו בֵּֽית־ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·wiḏ hō·lêḵ wā·šāḇ mê·‘al šā·’ūl lir·‘ō·wṯ ’eṯ- ṣōn ’ā·ḇîw bêṯ- lā·ḥem
verses.literal: but David went back and forth . . . from Saul to tend his father’s sheep in Bethlehem
verses.literalPt: Ora, Davi ia a Saul e voltava dele a apascentar as ovelhas de seu pai, em Belém.

verses.original: וַיִּגַּ֥שׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְהַעֲרֵ֑ב וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֖ב אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יֽוֹם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gaš hap·pə·liš·tî haš·kêm wə·ha·‘ă·rêḇ way·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm
verses.literal: For forty days the Philistine came forward every morning and evening to take his stand
verses.literalPt: O filisteu vinha de manhã e de tarde, apresentando-se por quarenta dias.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יִשַׁ֜י לְדָוִ֣ד בְּנ֗וֹ קַח־ נָ֤א לְאַחֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵיפַ֤ת הַקָּלִיא֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וַעֲשָׂרָ֥ה לֶ֖חֶם הַזֶּ֑ה וְהָרֵ֥ץ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה לְאַחֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yi·šay lə·ḏā·wiḏ bə·nōw qaḥ- nā lə·’a·ḥe·ḵā ’ê·p̄aṯ haq·qā·lî haz·zeh wa·‘ă·śā·rāh le·ḥem haz·zeh wə·hā·rêṣ ham·ma·ḥă·neh lə·’a·ḥe·ḵā
verses.literal: One day Jesse said to his son David Take . . . this ephah of roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread for your brothers and hurry to their camp
verses.literalPt: Disse Jessé a seu filho Davi: Toma, agora, para teus irmãos este efa de grão tostado e estes dez pães e corre a levá-los ao arraial a teus irmãos;

verses.original: וְ֠אֵת עֲשֶׂ֜רֶת חֲרִצֵ֤י הֶֽחָלָב֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה תָּבִ֖יא לְשַׂר־ הָאָ֑לֶף וְאֶת־ אַחֶ֙יךָ֙ תִּפְקֹ֣ד לְשָׁל֔וֹם וְאֶת־ עֲרֻבָּתָ֖ם תִּקָּֽח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ‘ă·śe·reṯ ḥă·ri·ṣê he·ḥā·lāḇ hā·’êl·leh tā·ḇî lə·śar- hā·’ā·lep̄ wə·’eṯ- ’a·ḥe·ḵā tip̄·qōḏ lə·šā·lō·wm wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·rub·bā·ṯām tiq·qāḥ
verses.literal: Take also these ten portions of cheese to the commander of their unit Check on the welfare of your brothers and bring back an assurance from them
verses.literalPt: leva também estes dez queijos ao seu comandante de mil, vê como passam teus irmãos e recebe deles a senha.

verses.original: וְשָׁא֤וּל וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ וְכָל־ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּעֵ֖מֶק הָֽאֵלָ֑ה נִלְחָמִ֖ים עִם־ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·’ūl wə·hêm·māh wə·ḵāl ’îš yiś·rā·’êl bə·‘ê·meq hā·’ê·lāh nil·ḥā·mîm ‘im- pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: They are with Saul and all the men of Israel in the Valley of Elah fighting against the Philistines
verses.literalPt: Saul com eles e todos os homens de Israel estão no vale de Elá, pelejando contra os filisteus.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם דָּוִ֜ד בַּבֹּ֗קֶר וַיִּטֹּ֤שׁ אֶת־ הַצֹּאן֙ עַל־ שֹׁמֵ֔ר וַיִּשָּׂ֣א וַיֵּ֔לֶךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖הוּ יִשָׁ֑י וַיָּבֹא֙ הַמַּעְגָּ֔לָה וְהַחַ֗יִל הַיֹּצֵא֙ אֶל־ הַמַּ֣עֲרָכָ֔ה וְהֵרֵ֖עוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kêm dā·wiḏ bab·bō·qer way·yiṭ·ṭōš ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣōn ‘al- šō·mêr way·yiś·śā way·yê·leḵ ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wā·hū yi·šāy way·yā·ḇō ham·ma‘·gā·lāh wə·ha·ḥa·yil hay·yō·ṣê ’el- ham·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh wə·hê·rê·‘ū bam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: So David got up early in the morning left the flock with a keeper loaded up and set out as Jesse had instructed him He reached the camp as the army was marching out to its position and shouting the battle cry
verses.literalPt: Levantou-se Davi de manhã cedo, deixou o rebanho ao cuidado dum guarda, carregou-se e partiu, como Jessé lhe tinha ordenado. Chegou às trincheiras no momento em que o exército ia sair para formar em linha de batalha e dava sinal de combate.

verses.original: וַתַּעֲרֹ֤ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מַעֲרָכָ֖ה לִקְרַ֥את מַעֲרָכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘ă·rōḵ yiś·rā·’êl ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh liq·raṯ ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh
verses.literal: And Israel and the Philistines arrayed in formation against each other
verses.literalPt: Israel e os filisteus puseram-se em ordem de batalha, exército contra exército.

verses.original: וַיִּטֹּשׁ֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶת־ הַכֵּלִ֜ים מֵעָלָ֗יו עַל־ יַד֙ שׁוֹמֵ֣ר הַכֵּלִ֔ים וַיָּ֖רָץ הַמַּעֲרָכָ֑ה וַיָּבֹ֕א וַיִּשְׁאַ֥ל לְאֶחָ֖יו לְשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṭ·ṭōš dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- hak·kê·lîm mê·‘ā·lāw ‘al- yaḏ šō·w·mêr hak·kê·lîm way·yā·rāṣ ham·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh way·yā·ḇō way·yiš·’al lə·’e·ḥāw lə·šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: Then David left his supplies in . . . the care of the quartermaster . . . and ran to the battle line When he arrived he asked his brothers how they were doing
verses.literalPt: Davi deixou a sua carga entregue ao cuidado dum guarda da bagagem, correu ao exército e foi indagar de seus irmãos como passavam.

verses.original: וְה֣וּא׀ מְדַבֵּ֣ר עִמָּ֗ם וְהִנֵּ֣ה אִ֣ישׁ הַבֵּנַ֡יִם עוֹלֶ֞ה גָּלְיָת֩ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֨י שְׁמ֤וֹ מִגַּת֙ מִמַּעֲרוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר כַּדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע דָּוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū mə·ḏab·bêr ‘im·mām wə·hin·nêh ’îš hab·bê·na·yim ‘ō·w·leh gā·lə·yāṯ hap·pə·liš·tî šə·mōw mig·gaṯ mim·ma·ʿă·rōṯ pə·liš·tîm way·ḏab·bêr kad·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh way·yiš·ma‘ dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: And as he was speaking with them suddenly the champion . . . named Goliath the Philistine from Gath came forward from the ranks of the Philistines and shouted his usual words which David also heard
verses.literalPt: Quando estava falando com eles, eis que vinha subindo do exército dos filisteus o campeão, cujo nome era Golias, filisteu de Gate. Falou segundo aquelas palavras, e Davi ouviu-as.

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּרְאוֹתָ֖ם אֶת־ הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיָּנֻ֙סוּ֙ מִפָּנָ֔יו וַיִּֽירְא֖וּ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’îš yiś·rā·’êl bir·’ō·w·ṯām ’eṯ- hā·’îš way·yā·nu·sū mip·pā·nāw way·yî·rə·’ū mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: When all the men of Israel saw Goliath - they fled from him in great fear . . .
verses.literalPt: Todos os israelitas, tanto que viram o homem, fugiram de diante dele com muito medo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַרְּאִיתֶם֙ הָאִ֤ישׁ הָֽעֹלֶה֙ הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֛י לְחָרֵ֥ף אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֹלֶ֑ה וְֽ֠הָיָה הָאִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יַכֶּ֜נּוּ יַעְשְׁרֶ֥נּוּ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ׀ עֹ֣שֶׁר גָּד֗וֹל וְאֶת־ בִּתּוֹ֙ יִתֶּן־ ל֔וֹ וְאֵת֙ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יו יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה חָפְשִׁ֖י בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’îš yiś·rā·’êl har·rə·’î·ṯem hā·’îš hā·‘ō·leh haz·zeh kî lə·ḥā·rêp̄ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·leh wə·hā·yāh hā·’îš ’ă·šer- yak·ken·nū ya‘·šə·ren·nū ham·me·leḵ ‘ō·šer gā·ḏō·wl wə·’eṯ- bit·tōw yit·ten- lōw wə·’êṯ bêṯ ’ā·ḇîw ya·‘ă·śeh ḥā·p̄ə·šî bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now the men of Israel had been saying Do you see how this . . . man keeps coming out - to defy Israel To the man who kills him the king will give great riches And he will give him his daughter in marriage and exempt his father’s house from taxation in Israel
verses.literalPt: Diziam os homens de Israel: Vistes a este homem que subiu? Subiu para desafiar a Israel. Ao homem que o matar, o rei encherá de grandes riquezas, e lhe dará sua filha, e fará livre em Israel a casa de seu pai.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗ד אֶֽל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֞ים הָעֹמְדִ֣ים עִמּוֹ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ מַה־ יֵּעָשֶׂ֗ה לָאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַכֶּה֙ אֶת־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֣י הַלָּ֔ז וְהֵסִ֥יר חֶרְפָּ֖ה מֵעַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֣י מִ֗י הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֤י הֶֽעָרֵל֙ הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֣י חֵרֵ֔ף מַעַרְכ֖וֹת אֱלֹהִ֥ים חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’el- hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·‘ō·mə·ḏîm ‘im·mōw lê·mōr mah- yê·‘ā·śeh lā·’îš ’ă·šer yak·keh ’eṯ- hap·pə·liš·tî hal·lāz wə·hê·sîr ḥer·pāh mê·‘al yiś·rā·’êl kî mî hap·pə·liš·tî he·‘ā·rêl haz·zeh kî ḥê·rêp̄ ma·‘ar·ḵō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: David asked . . . the men who were standing with him . . . What will be done for the man who kills this Philistine and removes this disgrace from Israel Just who is this . . . uncircumcised Philistine that he should defy the armies of the living God
verses.literalPt: Falou Davi aos homens que se achavam perto dele: Que se fará ao homem que matar a esse filisteu e tirar o opróbrio de sobre Israel? Pois quem é esse filisteu incircuncidado, para desafiar os exércitos do Deus vivo?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ הָעָ֔ם כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֣ה יֵעָשֶׂ֔ה לָאִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַכֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw hā·‘ām kad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh lê·mōr kōh yê·‘ā·śeh lā·’îš ’ă·šer yak·ken·nū
verses.literal: The people told him about the offer saying That is what will be done for the man who kills him
verses.literalPt: O povo repetiu-lhe a mesma palavra, dizendo: Assim se fará a quem o matar.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֱלִיאָב֙ אָחִ֣יו הַגָּד֔וֹל בְּדַבְּר֖וֹ אֶל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֑ים וַיִּֽחַר־ אַף֩ אֱלִיאָ֨ב בְּדָוִ֜ד וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ לָמָּה־ זֶּ֣ה יָרַ֗דְתָּ וְעַל־ מִ֨י נָטַ֜שְׁתָּ מְעַ֨ט הַצֹּ֤אן הָהֵ֙נָּה֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אֲנִ֧י יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶת־ זְדֹנְךָ֗ וְאֵת֙ רֹ֣עַ לְבָבֶ֔ךָ כִּ֗י לְמַ֛עַן רְא֥וֹת הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה יָרָֽדְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ’ĕ·lî·’āḇ ’ā·ḥîw hag·gā·ḏō·wl bə·ḏab·bə·rōw ’el- hā·’ă·nā·šîm way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ ’ĕ·lî·’āḇ bə·ḏā·wiḏ way·yō·mer lām·māh- zeh yā·raḏ·tā wə·‘al- mî nā·ṭaš·tā mə·‘aṭ haṣ·ṣōn hā·hên·nāh bam·miḏ·bār ’ă·nî yā·ḏa‘·tî ’eṯ- zə·ḏō·nə·ḵā wə·’êṯ rō·a‘ lə·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā kî lə·ma·‘an rə·’ō·wṯ ham·mil·ḥā·māh yā·rā·ḏə·tā
verses.literal: Now when David’s oldest brother Eliab heard him speaking to the men his anger . . . burned against David Why have you come down here he asked And with whom did you leave those few sheep in the wilderness I know your pride and wickedness of heart . . . you have come down to see the battle
verses.literalPt: Eliabe, seu irmão mais velho, ouviu-o quando falava aos homens, acendeu-se a sua ira contra Davi e disse: Por que desceste? Ao cuidado de quem deixaste essas poucas ovelhas no deserto? Eu conheço a tua altivez e a malignidade do teu coração. Desceste para ver a batalha.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד מֶ֥ה עָשִׂ֖יתִי עָ֑תָּה הֲל֖וֹא דָּבָ֥ר הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ meh ‘ā·śî·ṯî ‘āt·tāh hă·lō·w dā·ḇār hū
verses.literal: What have I done now . . . said David Was it not just a question
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Davi: Que fiz eu agora? Não é grave o caso?

verses.original: וַיִּסֹּ֤ב מֵֽאֶצְלוֹ֙ אֶל־ מ֣וּל אַחֵ֔ר וַיֹּ֖אמֶר כַּדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַיְשִׁבֻ֤הוּ הָעָם֙ דָּבָ֔ר כַּדָּבָ֖ר הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·sōḇ mê·’eṣ·lōw ’el- mūl ’a·ḥêr way·yō·mer kad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh way·ši·ḇu·hū hā·‘ām dā·ḇār kad·dā·ḇār hā·ri·šō·wn
verses.literal: Then he turned from him toward . . . another and asked about the offer and those people answered him just as . . . the first ones had answered
verses.literalPt: Virou-se dele para outro e falou a mesma coisa. O povo respondeu-lhe como dantes.

verses.original: וַיְּשָּֽׁמְעוּ֙ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר דָּוִ֑ד וַיַּגִּ֥דוּ לִפְנֵֽי־ שָׁא֖וּל וַיִּקָּחֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yəš·šå̄·mə·ʿū had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer dib·ber dā·wiḏ way·yag·gi·ḏū lip̄·nê- šā·’ūl way·yiq·qā·ḥê·hū
verses.literal: Now David’s words were overheard . . . and reported to Saul who sent for him
verses.literalPt: Ouvidas as palavras que Davi falou, foram repetidas na presença de Saul, que mandou chamá-lo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל אַל־ יִפֹּ֥ל לֵב־ אָדָ֖ם עָלָ֑יו עַבְדְּךָ֣ יֵלֵ֔ךְ וְנִלְחַ֖ם עִם־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֥י הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’el- šā·’ūl ’al- yip·pōl lêḇ- ’ā·ḏām ‘ā·lāw ‘aḇ·də·ḵā yê·lêḵ wə·nil·ḥam ‘im- hap·pə·liš·tî haz·zeh
verses.literal: And David said to Saul Let no man’s heart fail on account of this Philistine Your servant will go and fight him . . .
verses.literalPt: Davi disse a Saul: Não desfaleça o coração de alguém por causa dele. O teu servo irá e pelejará com este filisteu.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל אֶל־ דָּוִ֗ד לֹ֤א תוּכַל֙ לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ אֶל־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֣י הַזֶּ֔ה לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם עִמּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ נַ֣עַר אַ֔תָּה וְה֛וּא אִ֥ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֖ה מִנְּעֻרָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl ’el- dā·wiḏ lō ṯū·ḵal lā·le·ḵeṯ ’el- hap·pə·liš·tî haz·zeh lə·hil·lā·ḥêm ‘im·mōw kî- na·‘ar ’at·tāh wə·hū ’îš mil·ḥā·māh min·nə·‘u·rāw
verses.literal: But Saul . . . . . . replied You cannot . . . go out against this Philistine to fight him . . . You are just a boy and he has been a warrior . . . from his youth
verses.literalPt: Saul disse a Davi: Não poderás ir contra esse filisteu para pelejar com ele, pois tu és jovem, e ele é guerreiro desde a sua mocidade.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל רֹעֶ֨ה הָיָ֧ה עַבְדְּךָ֛ לְאָבִ֖יו בַּצֹּ֑אן וּבָ֤א הָֽאֲרִי֙ וְאֶת־ הַדּ֔וֹב וְנָשָׂ֥א שֶׂ֖ה מֵהָעֵֽדֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’el- šā·’ūl rō·‘eh hā·yāh ‘aḇ·də·ḵā lə·’ā·ḇîw baṣ·ṣōn ū·ḇā hā·’ă·rî wə·’eṯ- had·dō·wḇ wə·nā·śā śeh mê·hā·‘ê·ḏer
verses.literal: David replied Your servant has been tending . . . his father’s sheep and whenever a lion . . . or a bear came and carried off a lamb from the flock
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Davi a Saul: O teu servo estava apascentando as ovelhas de seu pai; quando vinha um leão ou um urso e levava um cordeiro do meio do rebanho,

verses.original: וְיָצָ֧אתִי אַחֲרָ֛יו וְהִכִּתִ֖יו וְהִצַּ֣לְתִּי מִפִּ֑יו וַיָּ֣קָם עָלַ֔י וְהֶחֱזַ֙קְתִּי֙ בִּזְקָנ֔וֹ וְהִכִּתִ֖יו וַהֲמִיתִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣā·ṯî ’a·ḥă·rāw wə·hik·ki·ṯîw wə·hiṣ·ṣal·tî mip·pîw way·yā·qām ‘ā·lay wə·he·ḥĕ·zaq·tî biz·qā·nōw wə·hik·ki·ṯîw wa·hă·mî·tîw
verses.literal: I went after it struck it down and delivered the lamb from its mouth If it reared up against me I would grab it by its fur strike it down and kill it
verses.literalPt: eu corria após ele, e o matava, e lho arrancava da boca; e, levantando-se ele contra mim, eu o agarrava pelas queixadas, e o feria, e matava.

verses.original: גַּ֧ם אֶֽת־ הָאֲרִ֛י גַּם־ הַדּ֖וֹב הִכָּ֣ה עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְֽ֠הָיָה הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֨י הֶעָרֵ֤ל הַזֶּה֙ כְּאַחַ֣ד מֵהֶ֔ם כִּ֣י חֵרֵ֔ף מַעַרְכֹ֖ת אֱלֹהִ֥ים חַיִּֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: gam ’eṯ- hā·’ă·rî gam- had·dō·wḇ hik·kāh ‘aḇ·de·ḵā wə·hā·yāh hap·pə·liš·tî he·‘ā·rêl haz·zeh kə·’a·ḥaḏ mê·hem kî ḥê·rêp̄ ma·‘ar·ḵōṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: Your servant has killed lions . . . and bears this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them for he has defied the armies of the living God
verses.literalPt: Leão e urso matou o teu servo, e a esse filisteu incircuncidado fará como a um deles, visto que tem desafiado os exércitos do Deus vivo.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ דָּוִד֒ יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִצִּלַ֜נִי מִיַּ֤ד הָֽאֲרִי֙ וּמִיַּ֣ד הַדֹּ֔ב ה֣וּא יַצִּילֵ֔נִי מִיַּ֥ד הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י הַזֶּ֑הס וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֤וּל אֶל־ דָּוִד֙ לֵ֔ךְ וַֽיהוָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

verses.literal: David added The LORD who delivered me from the claws of the lion and the bear . . . will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine Go said Saul - and may the LORD be with you
verses.literalPt: Acrescentou Davi: Jeová, que me livrou das garras do leão e das garras do urso, livrar-me-á da mão desse filisteu. Saul disse a Davi: Vai, e Jeová seja contigo!

verses.original: וַיַּלְבֵּ֨שׁ שָׁא֤וּל אֶת־ דָּוִד֙ מַדָּ֔יו וְנָתַ֛ן ק֥וֹבַע נְחֹ֖שֶׁת עַל־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיַּלְבֵּ֥שׁ אֹת֖וֹ שִׁרְיֽוֹן׃

verses.literal: Then Saul clothed David in his own tunic put a bronze helmet on his head and dressed him in armor
verses.literalPt: Saul vestiu a Davi dos seus vestidos, e pôs-lhe sobre a cabeça um capacete de cobre, e vestiu-o duma couraça.

verses.original: וַיַּחְגֹּ֣ר דָּוִ֣ד אֶת־ חַ֠רְבּוֹ מֵעַ֨ל לְמַדָּ֜יו וַיֹּ֣אֶל לָלֶכֶת֮ כִּ֣י לֹֽא־ נִסָּה֒ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶל־ שָׁא֗וּל לֹ֥א אוּכַ֛ל לָלֶ֥כֶת בָּאֵ֖לֶּה כִּ֣י לֹ֣א נִסִּ֑יתִי וַיְסִרֵ֥ם דָּוִ֖ד מֵעָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·gōr dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- ḥar·bōw mê·‘al lə·mad·dāw way·yō·’el lā·le·ḵeṯ kî lō- nis·sāh way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’el- šā·’ūl lō ’ū·ḵal lā·le·ḵeṯ bā·’êl·leh kî lō nis·sî·ṯî way·si·rêm dā·wiḏ mê·‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: David strapped his sword over the tunic and tried to walk but he was not accustomed to them I cannot . . . walk in these . . . David said to Saul I am not accustomed to them So David took them off
verses.literalPt: Davi cingiu a espada sobre os seus vestidos e procurou andar, pois não os tinha experimentado. Davi disse a Saul: Não posso andar com estas coisas, porque não as tenho experimentado. Davi tirou-as de sobre si.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מַקְל֜וֹ בְּיָד֗וֹ וַיִּבְחַר־ ל֣וֹ חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה חַלֻּקֵֽי־ אֲבָנִ֣ים׀ מִן־ הַנַּ֡חַל וַיָּ֣שֶׂם אֹ֠תָם בִּכְלִ֨י הָרֹעִ֧ים אֲשֶׁר־ ל֛וֹ וּבַיַּלְק֖וּט וְקַלְּע֣וֹ בְיָד֑וֹ וַיִּגַּ֖שׁ אֶל־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּֽי׃

verses.literal: And David took his staff in his hand selected five smooth stones from the brook and put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag And with his sling in hand he approached . . . the Philistine
verses.literalPt: Tomou na mão o seu cajado, escolheu do leito da torrente cinco pedras mui lisas e meteu-as no bolso de pastor que trazia consigo, a saber, no surrão. Tinha na mão a funda; e foi-se chegando ao filisteu.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י הֹלֵ֥ךְ וְקָרֵ֖ב אֶל־ דָּוִ֑ד וְהָאִ֛ישׁ נֹשֵׂ֥א הַצִּנָּ֖ה לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ hap·pə·liš·tî hō·lêḵ wə·qā·rêḇ ’el- dā·wiḏ wə·hā·’îš nō·śê haṣ·ṣin·nāh lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: Now the Philistine . . . came closer and closer to David with his shield-bearer . . . . . . before him
verses.literalPt: O filisteu ia andando e aproximando-se de Davi, e o seu escudeiro ia adiante dele.

verses.original: וַיַּבֵּ֧ט הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֛י וַיִּרְאֶ֥ה אֶת־ דָּוִ֖ד וַיִּבְזֵ֑הוּ כִּֽי־ הָיָ֣ה נַ֔עַר וְאַדְמֹנִ֖י עִם־ יְפֵ֥ה מַרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yab·bêṭ hap·pə·liš·tî way·yir·’eh ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ way·yiḇ·zê·hū kî- hā·yāh na·‘ar wə·’aḏ·mō·nî ‘im- yə·p̄êh mar·’eh
verses.literal: When the Philistine looked and saw David he despised him because he was just a boy ruddy and handsome . . .
verses.literalPt: Quando o filisteu olhou e viu a Davi, desprezou-o, porquanto era mancebo ruivo e de gentil aspecto.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔ד הֲכֶ֣לֶב אָנֹ֔כִי כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֥ה בָֽא־ אֵלַ֖י בַּמַּקְל֑וֹת וַיְקַלֵּ֧ל הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֛י אֶת־ דָּוִ֖ד בֵּאלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hap·pə·liš·tî ’el- dā·wiḏ hă·ḵe·leḇ ’ā·nō·ḵî kî- ’at·tāh ḇā- ’ê·lay bam·maq·lō·wṯ way·qal·lêl hap·pə·liš·tî ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ bê·lō·hāw
verses.literal: Am I a dog he said to David that you come at me with sticks And the Philistine cursed David by his gods
verses.literalPt: Disse o filisteu a Davi: Sou eu algum cão, para tu vires a mim com um pau? Em nome dos seus deuses, amaldiçoou o filisteu a Davi.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י אֶל־ דָּוִ֑ד לְכָ֣ה אֵלַ֔י וְאֶתְּנָה֙ אֶת־ בְּשָׂ֣רְךָ֔ לְע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hap·pə·liš·tî ’el- dā·wiḏ lə·ḵāh ’ê·lay wə·’et·tə·nāh ’eṯ- bə·śā·rə·ḵā lə·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim ū·lə·ḇe·hĕ·maṯ haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: Come . . . here he called to David and I will give your flesh to the birds of the air and the beasts of the field
verses.literalPt: Disse mais o filisteu a Davi: Vem a mim, e darei as tuas carnes às aves do céu e às bestas do campo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י אַתָּה֙ בָּ֣א אֵלַ֔י בְּחֶ֖רֶב וּבַחֲנִ֣ית וּבְכִיד֑וֹן וְאָנֹכִ֣י בָֽא־ אֵלֶ֗יךָ בְּשֵׁם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֛י מַעַרְכ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר חֵרַֽפְתָּ׃

verses.literal: But David said to the Philistine You come against me with sword and spear and javelin but I come against you in the name of the LORD of Hosts the God of the armies of Israel whom you have defied
verses.literalPt: Então, lhe respondeu Davi: Tu vens a mim com espada, e com lança, e com escudo; eu, porém, venho a ti em nome de Jeová dos Exércitos, do Deus das tropas de Israel, as quais tens desafiado.

verses.original: הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֡ה יְסַגֶּרְךָ֩ יְהוָ֨ה בְּיָדִ֜י וְהִכִּיתִ֗ךָ וַהֲסִרֹתִ֤י אֶת־ רֹֽאשְׁךָ֙ מֵעָלֶ֔יךָ וְנָ֨תַתִּ֜י פֶּ֣גֶר מַחֲנֵ֤ה פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה לְע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְחַיַּ֣ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיֵֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֛י יֵ֥שׁ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

verses.literal: This day the LORD will deliver you into my hand This day I will strike you down cut off your head . . . - and give the carcasses of the Philistine army to the birds of the air and the creatures of the earth Then the whole world will know that there is a God in Israel
verses.literalPt: Hoje mesmo, Jeová te entregará nas minhas mãos; matar-te-ei e tirar-te-ei a cabeça. Darei, hoje, às aves do céu e às feras do campo os cadáveres do arraial dos filisteus, e toda a terra saberá que há Deus em Israel.

verses.original: וְיֵֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל־ הַקָּהָ֣ל הַזֶּ֔ה כִּֽי־ לֹ֛א בְּחֶ֥רֶב וּבַחֲנִ֖ית יְהוֹשִׁ֣יעַ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י לַֽיהוָה֙ הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְנָתַ֥ן אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּיָדֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·ḏə·‘ū kāl- haq·qā·hāl haz·zeh kî- lō bə·ḥe·reḇ ū·ḇa·ḥă·nîṯ yə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ Yah·weh kî Yah·weh ham·mil·ḥā·māh wə·nā·ṯan ’eṯ·ḵem bə·yā·ḏê·nū
verses.literal: And all those assembled here will know that it is not by sword or spear that the LORD saves for the battle is the LORD’s and He will give all of you into our hands
verses.literalPt: Saberá toda esta congregação que Jeová salva, não pela espada e lança. Porque de Jeová é a guerra, e ele vos entregará nas nossas mãos.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כִּֽי־ קָ֣ם הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ וַיִּקְרַ֖ב לִקְרַ֣את דָּוִ֑ד וַיְמַהֵ֣ר דָּוִ֔ד וַיָּ֥רָץ הַמַּעֲרָכָ֖ה לִקְרַ֥את הַפְּלִשְׁתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- qām hap·pə·liš·tî way·yê·leḵ way·yiq·raḇ liq·raṯ dā·wiḏ way·ma·hêr dā·wiḏ way·yā·rāṣ ham·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh liq·raṯ hap·pə·liš·tî
verses.literal: As . . . the Philistine started forward to attack him David ran quickly toward the battle line to meet him
verses.literalPt: Como o filisteu se levantasse e viesse chegando para se encontrar com Davi, apressou-se este e correu em direção do exército para se encontrar com o filisteu.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶת־ יָד֜וֹ אֶל־ הַכֶּ֗לִי וַיִּקַּ֨ח מִשָּׁ֥ם אֶ֙בֶן֙ וַיְקַלַּ֔ע וַיַּ֥ךְ אֶת־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י אֶל־ מִצְח֑וֹ וַתִּטְבַּ֤ע הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ בְּמִצְח֔וֹ וַיִּפֹּ֥ל עַל־ פָּנָ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃

verses.literal: Then David reached . . . into his bag took out a stone and slung it striking the Philistine on the forehead The stone sank into his forehead and he fell facedown on the ground
verses.literalPt: Davi meteu a mão no bolso e tirou dali uma pedra. Arrojou-a com a funda e feriu ao filisteu na testa; a pedra encravou-se-lhe na testa, e ele caiu com o rosto em terra.

verses.original: וַיֶּחֱזַ֨ק דָּוִ֤ד מִן־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי֙ בַּקֶּ֣לַע וּבָאֶ֔בֶן וַיַּ֥ךְ אֶת־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י וַיְמִיתֵ֑הוּ וְחֶ֖רֶב אֵ֥ין בְּיַד־ דָּוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq dā·wiḏ min- hap·pə·liš·tî baq·qe·la‘ ū·ḇā·’e·ḇen way·yaḵ ’eṯ- hap·pə·liš·tî way·mî·ṯê·hū wə·ḥe·reḇ ’ên bə·yaḏ- dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: Thus David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone without a sword in his hand . . . he struck down the Philistine and killed him
verses.literalPt: Assim, Davi prevaleceu contra o filisteu com uma funda e com uma pedra; feriu ao filisteu e o matou, porém não havia espada na mão de Davi.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣רָץ דָּ֠וִד וַיַּעֲמֹ֨ד אֶל־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֜י וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ חַ֠רְבּוֹ וַֽיִּשְׁלְפָ֤הּ מִתַּעְרָהּ֙ וַיְמֹ֣תְתֵ֔הוּ וַיִּכְרָת־ בָּ֖הּ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיִּרְא֧וּ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֛ים כִּֽי־ מֵ֥ת גִּבּוֹרָ֖ם וַיָּנֻֽסוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·rāṣ dā·wiḏ way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ ’el- hap·pə·liš·tî way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ḥar·bōw way·yiš·lə·p̄āh mit·ta‘·rāh way·mō·ṯə·ṯê·hū way·yiḵ·rāṯ- bāh ’eṯ- rō·šōw way·yir·’ū hap·pə·liš·tîm kî- mêṯ gib·bō·w·rām way·yā·nu·sū
verses.literal: David ran and stood over him He grabbed the Philistine’s sword and pulled it from its sheath and killed him and he cut off his head with the sword When the Philistines saw that their hero was dead they turned and ran
verses.literalPt: Correu Davi, e pôs-se em pé sobre o filisteu, e tomou a espada dele, e, tirando-a da bainha, matou-o, e com ela decepou-lhe a cabeça. Vendo os filisteus que era morto o seu campeão, fugiram.

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֣מוּ אַנְשֵׁי֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל וִיהוּדָ֜ה וַיָּרִ֗עוּ וַֽיִּרְדְּפוּ֙ אֶת־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים עַד־ בּוֹאֲךָ֣ גַ֔יְא וְעַ֖ד שַׁעֲרֵ֣י עֶקְר֑וֹן וַֽיִּפְּל֞וּ חַֽלְלֵ֤י פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ שַׁעֲרַ֔יִם וְעַד־ גַּ֖ת וְעַד־ עֶקְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū ’an·šê yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh way·yā·ri·‘ū way·yir·də·p̄ū ’eṯ- hap·pə·liš·tîm ‘aḏ- bō·w·’ă·ḵā ḡay wə·‘aḏ ša·‘ă·rê ‘eq·rō·wn way·yip·pə·lū ḥal·lê p̄ə·liš·tîm bə·ḏe·reḵ ša·‘ă·ra·yim wə·‘aḏ- gaṯ wə·‘aḏ- ‘eq·rō·wn
verses.literal: Then the men of Israel and Judah charged forward with a shout and pursued the Philistines to the entrance of Gath and to the gates of Ekron And the bodies of the Philistines were strewn along the Shaaraim road to Gath . . . and Ekron
verses.literalPt: Os homens de Israel e de Judá levantaram-se, gritaram e perseguiram aos filisteus, até a entrada de Gate e até Ecrom. Os feridos dentre os filisteus caíram pelo caminho de Saaraim, até Gate e até Ecrom.

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִדְּלֹ֖ק אַחֲרֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיָּשֹׁ֖סּוּ אֶת־ מַחֲנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šu·ḇū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mid·də·lōq ’a·ḥă·rê p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yā·šōs·sū ’eṯ- ma·ḥă·nê·hem
verses.literal: When the Israelites . . . returned from their pursuit . . . of the Philistines they plundered their camps
verses.literalPt: Voltando os filhos de Israel de perseguirem aos filisteus, despojaram o arraial deles.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח דָּוִד֙ אֶת־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י וַיְבִאֵ֖הוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאֶת־ כֵּלָ֖יו שָׂ֥ם בְּאָהֳלֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- rōš hap·pə·liš·tî way·ḇi·’ê·hū yə·rū·šā·lim wə·’eṯ- kê·lāw śām bə·’ā·ho·lōw
verses.literal: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem and he put Goliath’s weapons in his own tent
verses.literalPt: Tomando Davi a cabeça do filisteu, levou-a para Jerusalém; porém pôs as armas dele na sua tenda.

verses.original: וְכִרְא֨וֹת שָׁא֜וּל אֶת־ דָּוִ֗ד יֹצֵא֙ לִקְרַ֣את הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י אָמַ֗ר אֶל־ אַבְנֵר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֔א בֶּן־ מִי־ זֶ֥ה הַנַּ֖עַר אַבְנֵ֑ר וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְנֵ֔ר חֵֽי־ נַפְשְׁךָ֥ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אִם־ יָדָֽעְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵir·’ō·wṯ šā·’ūl ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ yō·ṣê liq·raṯ hap·pə·liš·tî ’ā·mar ’el- ’aḇ·nêr śar haṣ·ṣā·ḇā ben- mî- zeh han·na·‘ar ’aḇ·nêr way·yō·mer ’aḇ·nêr ḥê- nap̄·šə·ḵā ham·me·leḵ ’im- yā·ḏā·‘ə·tî
verses.literal: As Saul had watched David going out to confront the Philistine he said to Abner the commander of the army Abner whose son is this young man As surely as you live O king Abner replied I do not know
verses.literalPt: Quando Saul viu a Davi sair contra o filisteu, perguntou a Abner, o general do exército: Abner, de quem é filho este mancebo? Respondeu Abner: Por tua vida, ó rei, que o não sei.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ שְׁאַ֣ל אַתָּ֔ה בֶּן־ מִי־ זֶ֖ה הָעָֽלֶם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ šə·’al ’at·tāh ben- mî- zeh hā·‘ā·lem
verses.literal: Find out . . . whose son this young man is! said the king
verses.literalPt: Disse o rei: Pergunta de quem é filho esse rapaz.

verses.original: וּכְשׁ֣וּב דָּוִ֗ד מֵֽהַכּוֹת֙ אֶת־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ אַבְנֵ֔ר וַיְבִאֵ֖הוּ לִפְנֵ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וְרֹ֥אשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·šūḇ dā·wiḏ mê·hak·kō·wṯ ’eṯ- hap·pə·liš·tî way·yiq·qaḥ ’ō·ṯōw ’aḇ·nêr way·ḇi·’ê·hū lip̄·nê šā·’ūl wə·rōš hap·pə·liš·tî bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: So when David returned from killing the Philistine still holding his head in his hand Abner took him and brought him before Saul
verses.literalPt: Voltando Davi depois de morto o filisteu, tomou-o Abner e levou-o à presença de Saul, trazendo Davi na mão a cabeça do filisteu.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ שָׁא֔וּל בֶּן־ מִ֥י אַתָּ֖ה הַנָּ֑עַר וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד בֶּֽן־ עַבְדְּךָ֥ יִשַׁ֖י בֵּ֥ית הַלַּחְמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw šā·’ūl ben- mî ’at·tāh han·nā·‘ar way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ben- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā yi·šay bêṯ hal·laḥ·mî
verses.literal: Whose son are you young man asked Saul I am the son of your servant Jesse of Bethlehem David replied
verses.literalPt: Saul perguntou-lhe: De quem és filho, mancebo? Respondeu Davi: Sou filho do teu servo Jessé, belemita.
